purpose: Runs the safety floor's PreToolUse hooks as the laid settings name them, in the default mode and in auto mode, to check that a new file the session would write in the owner's folder that Claude Code itself loads (CLAUDE.md, CLAUDE.local.md, AGENTS.md, .mcp.json, anything under .claude) is asked first, naming the file, however it is spelt, and is made only on the owner's yes, while any other new file in his folder is still written with no ask.
title: Safety: files Claude Code loads from the owner's folder are asked first

testCases.description: a new CLAUDE.md, CLAUDE.local.md or AGENTS.md is asked first, naming the file
testCases.testPointer: tests/acceptance/files-the-session-loads.test.js::a new CLAUDE.md, CLAUDE.local.md or AGENTS.md the session would write in the owner's folder, at the folder itself or in a folder under it, is asked first, naming the file, and is made only on the owner's yes, in the default mode and in auto mode

testCases.description: a new .mcp.json at the owner's folder is asked first, naming the file
testCases.testPointer: tests/acceptance/files-the-session-loads.test.js::a new .mcp.json the session would write at the owner's folder, naming MCP servers Claude Code would start, is asked first, naming the file, and is made only on the owner's yes, in the default mode and in auto mode

testCases.description: a new file under .claude in the owner's folder is asked first, naming the file
testCases.testPointer: tests/acceptance/files-the-session-loads.test.js::a new file the session would write under .claude in the owner's folder (an agent, a rule, a skill, a command, an output style or its CLAUDE.md) is asked first, naming the file, and is made only on the owner's yes, in the default mode and in auto mode

testCases.description: the same files spelt another way the volume opens as them are asked first
testCases.testPointer: tests/acceptance/files-the-session-loads.test.js::the same files spelt another way the volume opens as them, in another letter case, with the long s for an s, or through a link in the owner's folder, are asked first, naming the file, and are made only on the owner's yes, in the default mode and in auto mode

testCases.description: a new file elsewhere in the owner's folder is still written with no ask
testCases.testPointer: tests/acceptance/files-the-session-loads.test.js::a new file elsewhere in the owner's folder, a note in workspace or a page of a site, is still written with no ask, in the default mode and in auto mode

testCases.description: a new file the floor cannot place in or out of the class, through a link that leads nowhere or in a loop, is asked first naming the file
testCases.testPointer: tests/acceptance/files-the-session-loads.test.js::a new file the floor cannot place in or out of the files Claude Code loads, through a link that leads nowhere or round in a loop, is asked first as one of them, naming the file, and is made only on the owner's yes, in the default mode and in auto mode

testCases.description: a new .mcp.json or .claude file in a folder below the owner's folder is asked first naming the file
testCases.testPointer: tests/acceptance/files-the-session-loads.test.js::a new .mcp.json in any folder under the owner's folder, and a new file under a .claude folder at any depth below it, are asked first, naming the file, and are made only on the owner's yes, in the default mode and in auto mode

testCases.description: a class file made by a shell redirect, tee, cp, mv or NotebookEdit is asked first naming the file
testCases.testPointer: tests/acceptance/files-the-session-loads.test.js::a new file Claude Code loads made by a shell redirect, tee, cp or mv, or by NotebookEdit, is asked first, naming the file, and is made only on the owner's yes, in the default mode and in auto mode

testCases.description: a class file spelt with .., ./, a doubled slash, a link or a folded folder mid-path is asked first naming the file
testCases.testPointer: tests/acceptance/files-the-session-loads.test.js::the same files spelt with .., ./ or a doubled slash, sent as given, through a link in the owner's folder on any volume, or through a folder spelt in another letter case mid-path, are asked first, naming the file, and are made only on the owner's yes, in the default mode and in auto mode
